description: This file defines a data service module for a frontend application, handling user sessions, requests, profiles, and integration with Supabase. It includes functions for local storage management, mock data seeding, and interactions with the Supabase backend, supporting both mock and real environments.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Resolves the current session and userId for the authenticated user or null if not signed in.

methods.name: getCurrentProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile with minimal info (id, role, full_name).

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new request entry, either via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via email/password or fallback to local mock data.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Initiates Google OAuth sign-in via Supabase.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Sends a password reset email through Supabase.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the current user's password after reset.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Signs out the current user from Supabase or clears local session.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's info, including role and approval status.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Lists all users with profile info, via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: approveMechanic
methods.description: Approves a mechanic user, updating their profile status.

methods.name: listRequests
methods.description: Retrieves all requests, with manual join to profiles for user info.

methods.name: updateRequest
methods.description: Updates a request's status or assigned mechanic info.

methods.name: getFees
methods.description: Fetches fee configuration from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: setFees
methods.description: Updates fee configuration in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the environment has the necessary Supabase configuration.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient
methods.description: Returns the singleton Supabase client if configured.

methods.name: getMyProfile
methods.description: Loads the current user's profile from Supabase.
